title: Where labels could come from on the public instance
compared: Failed jobs that got a bug or ticket reference, by who set it, and jobs that got an LLM comment, by whether a person later reviewed them.
sample: 42 days of four public job groups (Tumbleweed, its Development group, AArch64, Leap 16); jobs, not comments.

distinct references set by a person

in the Development group, reviewed by a person

verdict: A person set the reference on 90 jobs in 42 days, none for infrastructure, and people reviewed 2.2% of the jobs the model commented. Too few labels to train or tune on.
note: Reviewed means a person later set a bug reference or a label on the job.
